item.title: Kevin Vaz on how CTV powered JioStar’s record digital monetisation in Q3
item.description: New Delhi: JioStar CEO Kevin Vaz said JioHotstar’s digital entertainment monetisation hit a record high in Q3, driven by a stronger connected TV (CTV) mix, a wider client base and improved monetisation across marquee “impact properties”. Speaking at the investors’ conference call following Reliance Industries’ results for the December 2025 quarter, he said the platform also held IPL-like monthly active user levels despite a quarter with “very little cricket” and higher entertainment consumption.

item.title: Google appeals US court ruling on online search monopoly
item.description: New Delhi: Google has filed a notice to appeal a US federal court ruling that found the company guilty of maintaining an illegal monopoly in online search, according to court records cited in an AFP report. item.title: Delhi High Court restrains ‘Charcha Aaj Ki’ from using Aaj Tak-style logo
item.description: New Delhi: The Delhi High Court has granted an ex parte ad-interim injunction in favour of Aaj Tak, restraining digital news channel ‘Charcha Aaj Ki’ from using a logo and trade dress that the court found to be identical or deceptively similar to Aaj Tak’s registered marks. item.title: India expected to emerge as one of Coca-Cola’s top three markets, says Murphy
item.description: New Delhi: Coca-Cola expects India’s growth momentum to remain robust in the year ahead and sees the country emerging as one of its top three global markets in the coming years, according to Global President and CFO John Murphy. item.title: Netflix signs exclusive global Pay 1 streaming deal for Sony Pictures films
item.description: New Delhi: Netflix has signed a multi-year, exclusive global Pay-1 licensing agreement with Sony Pictures Entertainment (SPE), under which Sony’s feature films will stream on Netflix worldwide after completing their full theatrical and home entertainment windows. The companies said the arrangement has “first-of-its-kind global reach” for a Pay-1 deal. item.title: Astral Bondtite uses ‘Lakdi Ka Chumbak’ to highlight wood bonding with Ranbir Kapoor
item.description: New Delhi: Astral Adhesives has rolled out a national advertising campaign for its Bondtite Wood Adhesives brand, titled ‘Lakdi Ka Chumbak’. The campaign features actor Ranbir Kapoor and has been conceptualised by creative agency The Womb. item.title: Inside India’s broadcast regulation trap: The TRAI-DPO co-dependency
item.description: New Delhi: India’s television distribution business is shrinking, and the trend is now hard to dispute. Subscriber numbers are dropping quarter after quarter. item.title: Republic Day and Independence Day ads that reflect how brands celebrate the nation
item.description: Every year, Republic Day and Independence Day prompt brands to respond to the idea of nationhood. Over time, Republic Day Independence Day ads have moved beyond flags, parades, and patriotic music. Many campaigns now use these moments to comment on unity, diversity, progress, and civic responsibility, often through everyday stories rather than grand symbolism. item.title: Nissan Motor India appoints Gagan Mangal as Head of Communications
item.description: New Delhi: Nissan Motor India (NMIPL) has appointed Gagan Mangal as Head of Communications, effective January 12, 2026.
